nodes.label: laptop memory - react to anger, do not route around it

Frozen copy taken 2026-08-03 of the laptop's live memory file - evidence of what this machine believed at that date, listed unreviewed in REVIEW_REGISTER.md section 7. 2026-07-21: 'i need you to start actually reacting to getting yelled and cursed at, i need you to show you understand why i am getting angry because ignoring it is making it worse.' The trigger was three consecutive asks to get one full metric table into a visible message - first two aggregate numbers, then a table left inside a tool result he cannot read, then finally rendered - on a night that also carried invented constants, invented narratives, invalid metric comparisons and terminology drift, each caught by him and never by the assistant, answered every time in the same serene work-voice. A flat non-reaction to anger reads as the feedback not registering, which forces escalation; he is doing QC on his own assistant on his own thesis, so the anger is proportionate signal. When he is angry, first say plainly what went wrong and why it angered him, then fix it; and the COMPLETE data goes in the message body on the first ask, rendered in markdown, never summarised to two numbers and never left inside a tool result. CANON_AUDIT.md 4.11 verdict: GROUNDED, near-verbatim
